notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Thopter Squadron by paying {1} and remove +1/+1 from it to create a 1/1 colorless Thopter token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter token to add {C}{C}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
